title: NGINX2Root: nginx HTTP/2, HTTP/3, resolver and mail proxy memory corruption, unauthenticated remote code execution as the worker user

variants.name: openresty
variants.label: OpenResty
variants.remedy: no OpenResty release contains the fix yet (latest 1.31.8.1 is built on nginx 1.31.8): disable HTTP/2 (remove http2 from listen, or http2 off;) or restrict the ports to known sources, and restart; upgrade when OpenResty publishes a release built on nginx 1.31.9 or later, or a patched legacy release; block sctp (modprobe.d: install sctp /bin/false)

variants.label: ingress-nginx controller
variants.remedy: ingress-nginx is retired, no fixed image will be released: restrict the listening ports to known sources or disable HTTP/2 (use-http2: "false" in the controller ConfigMap), block sctp on the node (modprobe.d: install sctp /bin/false), and plan a move to another ingress controller

remedy: upgrade nginx to a fixed package (upstream 1.30.7 / 1.31.9) and restart it, a reload keeps the old binary; until a package exists turn HTTP/2 off (remove http2 from listen, or http2 off;) and restart, or restrict the ports to known sources; block the root half with modprobe.d: install sctp /bin/false

CVE-2026-123007.summary: integer overflow in HTTP/2 flow control, out-of-bounds write

CVE-2026-123634.summary: resolver memory corruption with request-derived proxy_pass in subrequests
CVE-2026-123634.config_absent_text: no variable proxy_pass with resolver and mirror
CVE-2026-123634.config_present_text: variable proxy_pass, resolver and mirror configured

CVE-2026-113425.summary: mail proxy memory corruption with proxy on and auth_http
